授業概要
This lecture is divided into three parts; environmental, material and battery.
This part of the syllabus will cover the environmental side of the course by giving students an introduction to the scientific and engineering principles needed to analyze and solve environmental engineering problems, and experience in the practice of environmental engineering related to air, water, and wastewater management.
The course will examine key concepts in water pollution, air pollution, hazardous wastes, environmental standards, and global atmospheric change. This broad survey will aid your understanding of the interesting and complex environmental topics.
In the material part, the structural materials that support the energy industry will be introduced. Using advanced materials for power generation systems as an example, lectures will be given on the needs, the mechanisms of properties, and the material designs. In addition, lectures will be given on basic terms, definitions, measurement methods of mechanical properties.
In the battery part, students will learn an introduction of electrochemistry to understand battery principle. In addition, you will also learn about the advanced topic on next generation batteries and it related materials.
